definitions.explanation: Going beyond what is appropriate or reasonable. Used to describe behavior, amounts, or conditions that exceed healthy or acceptable limits.

examples.japanese: {過度|かど}な⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧。
examples.english: Excessive drinking is bad for the body.

examples.japanese: {過度|かど}な⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧になった。
examples.english: Excessive stress was the cause of the illness.

examples.japanese: {過度|かど}な⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦プレッシャー→プレッシャー：07163_puresshaa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}えて→与える：01821_ataeru⟧しまう。
examples.english: Placing excessive expectations on children puts pressure on them.

notes:
USAGE:
{過度|かど} is almost always used as a modifier with な, describing something that goes beyond reasonable limits. It is formal in tone and common in medical, health, and policy writing.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {過度|かど}な + noun (excessive...)
- {過度|かど}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + verb/adjective (excessively...)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過度|かど}な⟦ストレス→ストレス：03827_sutoresu⟧ (excessive stress)
- {過度|かど}な⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧ (excessive drinking)
- {過度|かど}な⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧ (excessive exercise)
- {過度|かど}な⟦{期待|きたい}→期待：00238_kitai⟧ (excessive expectations)
- {過度|かど}な⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧ (excessive worry)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{過剰|かじょう}→過剰：04123_kajou⟧ (surplus, excess) emphasizes having too much of something. {過度|かど} emphasizes that the degree or extent has gone too far.
